title: JMAP-level error in load_startup_data silently empties chat list
description: If Chat/get or ChatContact/get returns a JMAP method-level error response (e.g. ["error", {"type": "accountNotFound"}, "c0"]), load_startup_data treats the missing 'list' field as an empty array and replaces state.chat_list and state.chat_ids with empty vecs. connection_status is not updated. The user sees a blank chat panel with no error indicator and the status bar still shows 'Connecting'.
